facts.business: Twamev Construction and Infrastructure Limited operates as an Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) company providing end-to-end project execution solutions across infrastructure, industrial, institutional and other construction segments.

auditor.name: J Jain and Company
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: (a) Company in process of making full and final settlement of resolution plan amount of Rs 2100 Lakh subject to account upgradation from NPA per NCLT Kolkata Order dated 14 July 2024. (b) Company initiated reconciliation process with Trade Receivables, Advances to Vendors and Creditors; made provision of Rs Nil (PY Rs 664 Lakh) for estimated credit loss based on management assessment. (c) Exceptional Item of INR -72 Lakh (Previous Year 4433 Lakh) includes provision for Sundry Debtors written back.

key_risks: Increasing competition within the infrastructure sector
Material uncertainty exists as on date of audit report regarding ability to meet liabilities
Delays in implementation of Approved Resolution Plan and transfer of promoter shares
Reconciliation of Trade Receivables, Advances to Vendors and Creditors
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
